facts.fact: Newsmada reports the GIZ ProPFR project piloted an interconnected land information system linking topographic circumscriptions and land offices (guichets fonciers).
The land services director general (DGSF) says a land information system, aimed at digitising and centralising land documents and data nationwide under PNF II, will be operational soon.

systems.owner: DGSF, Ministère de la Décentralisation et de l'Aménagement du Territoire

note: The kiosk issues certificates and plans from dematerialised CSJs and topographic plans; it does not say transfers, registrations or mortgages are processed electronically, nor that a land information system is being built.

facts.fact: Madagascar's decentralisation and land-planning ministry said in April 2025 that its land information system (SIF) will be deployed progressively in five pilot regions under National Land Programme II with African Development Fund support.

systems.owner: Ministry of Decentralisation and Land Planning

facts.fact: Newsmada reports that on 12 December 2023 computers, printers and solar kits were handed to the land offices of 291 communes under the World Bank-funded CASEF project as part of setting up a Land Information System.

note: Korean support for digitising land services is a stated intention, no system.
